cand.title: DiscoveryX 2027
cand.excerpt: Verified date and venue plus credible organized-demand mechanism; venue commitments reduce current accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Alicia Pereira, OCI Vice President, Marketing & Communications, is a verified organizer-side relationship/referral contact, officially published for media inquiries; she is not verified as a hotel contracting buyer. Priyanshi Gajjar-Desai, aNd Logistix Registration & Planning Coordinator, is a verified agency professional supporting registration, sponsorship fulfillment and logistics. Her name-associated agency address appears in the 2027 hotel link tracking metadata, suggesting operational involvement, not proving a 2027 appointment or purchasing authority. Ask these contacts to identify the accommodation decision-maker.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity dates: April 21–22, 2027, Enercare Centre, 100 Princes’ Blvd, Exhibition Place, Toronto, Ontario M6K 3C3, Canada. These are event dates, not publication dates, and are within the requested horizon. No official 2028 edition dates or venue were located; do not roll 2027 dates forward.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied Radisson Blu specifications: a 157-room Harbourfront hotel cannot house the full event or replace Enercare as the conference venue. MCI reports over 2,000 pre-registered delegates plus 318 onsite registrations for 2025; OCI describes thousands of attendees in 2026. Realistic roles are a small speaker/VIP, exhibitor or visiting-delegation block, independently booked delegates, and limited side meetings. Approximately 15–109 peak rooms is a hotel-side prospecting range from the supplied brief, NOT event demand or a forecast. City-business lodging is the relevant proposition; no resort retreat requirement was found. No catering or restaurant availability is assumed; verify before proposing receptions.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2027 venue is Enercare Centre at Exhibition Place, in Toronto proper and within the hotel’s supplied demand territory. This is a convention/exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. Public announcement establishes the selected venue, not access to the underlying contract or its exclusivity terms.
findings.historicalRotation: 2024: April 17–18, Enercare Centre, Toronto, corroborated by the University of Toronto event listing. 2025: April 16–17, Enercare Centre, Toronto, in OCI’s edition-specific exhibitor package. 2026: April 29–30, Enercare Centre, Toronto, in Exhibition Place’s listing. 2027: April 21–22 at the same venue. Verified recent continuity, not destination rotation. The OCI URL containing discoveryx-2024-conference now displays 2027 and must not be used to date 2024.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 official registration page publishes an attendee self-booking group link labelled “OCI DiscoveryX Room Block 2027” and states: “Please find the booking link below for attendees to reserve their rooms online. Kindly note that the group cut-off date is Monday, March 22, 2027.” The link targets Hyatt group-booking property code TORDH/G-OCI7. Hotel X Toronto is the single property identifiable from this published pathway: Hyatt’s TORDH property page identifies Hotel X Toronto. That 2027 property identification is an explicit inference from the matching property code; the booking endpoint could not be read to independently confirm block terms. Separately, the 2026 registration page explicitly states “Hotel X is our official hotel partner for DiscoveryX 2026” and gives 111 Princes’ Blvd, Toronto, Ontario M6K 3C3. No other edition-specific hotels were found. No public open lodging RFP or official housing bureau was identified. Do not treat sourcing as open; rate, allocation, stay dates, pickup and exclusivity remain unknown.
findings.organizationStructure: OCI owns/hosts the event and is an Ontario-incorporated not-for-profit corporation without share capital, government-funded; it should not be described simply as a government department or a membership association. MCI’s DiscoveryX 2025 case study explicitly classifies its service as PCO, Conferences & Trade Show Management and identifies aNd Logistix and MCI Canada’s ID division as the planning team. This verifies historical agency delivery, not a disclosed 2027 PCO contract. Enercare Centre is the venue; Hotel X is the verified 2026 hotel partner and inferred 2027 linked property; neither is the event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: 2027 already has a published room-block pathway, apparently at Hotel X Toronto; 2026 explicitly partnered with Hotel X. Hotel X’s published address is 111 Princes’ Blvd versus the venue’s 100 Princes’ Blvd, indicating an onsite-area convenience advantage over a Harbourfront alternative (inference). No sourced sell-out, unmet overflow, displaced delegates, block shortage, hotel performance concern or exclusivity restriction was found. Attendance cannot be translated into hotel rooms because the overnight share is unpublished.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Alicia Pereira for referral to the DiscoveryX accommodation lead and ask Priyanshi Gajjar-Desai whether she supports the 2027 room-block workflow. First confirm the 2027 linked hotel, contracting authority, existing allocation/exclusivity and whether additional speaker, exhibitor or delegation rooms are wanted. Only then offer a modest room-only subgroup proposal with actual availability and transport information. If 2027 has no opening, request the next housing review date and permission to participate. Verify Radisson restaurant/catering operations separately before any hosted-meeting proposal.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, venue selection is already announced and a hotel block is already marketed. Access to a primary hotel role is therefore constrained, not demonstrated open. A secondary block or subgroup relationship is a prospecting hypothesis requiring organizer approval; no Radisson allocation, overflow request or bookable event block is evidenced.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Recurring event language and the 2024–2027 Toronto/Enercare timeline support relationship development for later housing reviews. They do not establish an announced 2028 edition, a future RFP or a rotation window. Seek consideration as a supplementary downtown/Harbourfront hotel and ask when the next accommodation review occurs; do not pitch replacing the convention venue.
